tasks.short: Apply agronomy, forestry, or agriculture to a conservation objective.

steps.what: Apply principles of specialized fields of science, agronomy, forestry, and agriculture, to achieve conservation objectives.

tasks.design: She still applies agronomy, soil science, forestry, or agriculture on the site. The digest leaves field research and study design manual. Lab notebooks, literature screening, and annual-report checks are other tasks in this group, and this task has no second entry to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: The right principle depends on this soil, this stand, and this objective.
tasks.enabler_now: Report checks and notebook tools in this digest cover other tasks. Applying a specialized field to a conservation objective on a site stays with her, and the digest does not name a change for that judgement.
tasks.still_hard: She has to decide which field applies and what it implies for this land.
tasks.human_edge: The objective is met only if the principle fits the site she is standing on.
tasks.altitude: Applying the science on each site stays in her week. She gains no right to skip that judgement.

reach.task: Say which crop or soil limit binds on this site.
reach.learn: The limit is read on the site. A general note does not choose it.

evidence.claim: Applying a specialized field on a site is field judgement, and the digest leaves field research and study design manual.

assumptions: This task is the scientific judgement on the site. It is not a literature search and not an annual report.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether a colleague in soil science already supplies the soil limit before she applies it.
research_questions: On the last ten sites, did she apply the principle in the field, or only restate a note someone else had written?

already_counted.description: The scientific judgement on the site remains her work.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low and the high are zero. She still applies the principle on the site, and no second entry of that judgement is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan soil management and the practices that hold soil and water.

steps.what: Plan soil management practices: rotation, reforestation, and permanent vegetation.
Plan conservation practices: contour plowing or terracing to maintain soil or conserve water.

tasks.design: She still writes the practice plan. Rotation, reforestation, and permanent vegetation are the management choices. Contour plowing and terracing are the structures that hold soil or water, and they follow those choices. Both stay her work. The digest's plan line is a check of annual reports against a required-field list, not the choice of practices on a farm. No second typing of this plan is named.
tasks.previous_blocker: The practices have to fit this slope, this soil, and what the land user will actually do.
tasks.enabler_now: A required-field check of an annual report is a different task. Choosing rotation, vegetation, contour plowing, or terracing for this land stays with her. Land-cover imagery does not select those practices.
tasks.still_hard: She has to judge which practice will hold on this slope, and whether water or soil is the limit.
tasks.human_edge: A practice that ignores the slope fails in the first storm, and she is the one who signs the plan.
tasks.altitude: Writing the practice plan stays in her week. She gains no right to have a model choose the practices.

reach.task: Say which woody cover will hold on this slope.
reach.learn: The vegetation choice is part of the plan she still writes, not a list she accepts unread.

evidence.claim: Choosing conservation practices for a site is a plan she writes, and the digest's plan tooling is a required-field check of reports, not that choice.

assumptions: Both steps are the plan she writes today. Rotation and vegetation are the larger set of choices. Contour plowing and terracing are the structures.
Telling the land user about the plan is the advice task, not a second send inside this task.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether she also types the finished plan into a funder portal after she has written it.
research_questions: After the plan is written, does she type it again into a portal, or is the written plan the only version?

already_counted.description: The practice plan remains her writing, both the management choices and the structures.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low and the high are zero. She still writes both parts of the plan. A funder portal, if one exists, is not a step this task currently shows.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Watch a project during and after construction against the design.

steps.what: Monitor projects during or after construction to ensure projects conform to design specifications.

tasks.design: She still walks the work during construction and after it, and she still decides whether it matches the design specification. That judgement is spoken to the project lead on site. No second log of the visit is named, so none is removed. Land-cover imagery does not show whether a terrace matches its specification.
tasks.previous_blocker: Conformance is what was built on this site, compared with the specification, while the work is in front of her.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest leaves field research manual. A screen of regional land cover is a different question. This task is the visit during or after construction, and that visit stays hers.
tasks.still_hard: She has to see the built work and say whether it matches the specification.
tasks.human_edge: A terrace that misses the line fails in the field, and she is the one who was there.
tasks.altitude: The construction visit and the conformance judgement stay in her week.

reach.task: Be on site while the work is built.
reach.learn: The technician can stand the visit with her. The conformance call against the specification stays hers.

evidence.claim: Checking built work against a design specification is a site visit, and the digest leaves field research manual.

assumptions: The design specification already exists before she visits. This task is the visit and the conformance call, not a written report she then types again.
The call to the project lead is spoken on site, not a versioned send.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether her employer also requires a written visit note after the spoken call.
research_questions: After the site call, does she write the same conformance finding a second time, or is the spoken call the whole task?

already_counted.description: The site visit and the conformance call remain her work.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low and the high are zero. The visit and the conformance call stay. A later written note, if her employer requires one, is not a step this task currently shows.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise farmers and ranchers on plans, problems, and other solutions.

steps.what: Advise land users, farmers or ranchers, on plans, problems, or alternative conservation solutions.

tasks.design: She still advises the farmer or rancher in person on that holding's plans, problems, and alternative solutions. The digest says advising farmers stays manual. An answer page for routine public questions, such as a wetland rule, is a different task and is not this conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The advice has to fit this land user, this holding, and what they will agree to do.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest keeps advising farmers manual. An answer page is for routine public questions, not for this rancher's problem, so the conversation stays with her.
tasks.still_hard: She has to hear the problem and offer a solution the land user can carry out.
tasks.human_edge: The land user takes the advice from her, on the holding, or they do not take it.
tasks.altitude: Advising farmers and ranchers stays in her week. She gains no right to hand that conversation to a page.

reach.task: Say how many animals the forage will carry.
reach.learn: The stocking point can inform her advice. The conversation with the rancher stays hers.

evidence.claim: Advising farmers stays manual. An answer page is for routine public questions, not for advice on a holding.

assumptions: This task is the conversation with the land user. It is not a public question page and not a written notice she then sends.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether some routine wetland questions never reach her because a public page already answers them.
research_questions: Of her last twenty advice conversations, how many were a routine public rule, and how many were a holding-specific problem?

already_counted.description: The advice conversation remains her work.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low and the high are zero. Advising the farmer or rancher stays a conversation, and no second entry of that advice is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Applying the science, writing the practice plan, walking construction against the specification, and advising the land user all stay hers. Nothing in these four tasks is a second entry that goes away.
skills_to_grow: Match the scientific field to the site in front of her.
Choose rotation, vegetation, contour plowing, or terracing for that slope.
Say on site whether the built work matches the specification.
Advise the farmer or rancher in a conversation they can act on.
role.ambitious_version: She still applies the science on each site, still writes the practice plan, still walks the construction, and still advises the land user. She does not gain a right to let a model choose the practice or give the advice.
